stage: LoRA weight adaptation of text attention; visual encoder and base weights frozen
prompt: Image 1 is the clean figure with its legend and numerical rules. Image 2 is the same figure with A/B pointer marks. A/B are at the centers of the gaps in those marks. Read the displayed colors and the written rules. Extract one reusable numerical representation, without calculating any final answers. Return only a JSON object with exactly two keys: "values" and "offsets". "values" has exactly keys "A" and "B". Each has exactly "base" (the displayed numerical value) and "offset" (an offset variable name). "offsets" maps each used variable name to a list of every permitted numerical offset value. Reuse the SAME variable name when the rules specify one shared offset. Use DIFFERENT names for separate offsets. A known offset has a one-element list. Do not include unused variables. A value means base plus its named offset. Distinct named offsets vary independently. Example of the JSON shape, with placeholders to replace: {"values":{"A":{"base":number,"offset":"name1"},"B":{"base":number,"offset":"name2"}},"offsets":{"name1":[numbers],"name2":[numbers]}}. If a shared name is used, include it only once in offsets. If unreadable, return null. Do not explain.
training: One fixed epoch; assistant JSON tokens only; 48 optimizer updates; final checkpoint only; no dev/test model selection.
smoke: Two train examples, development examples only; require finite gradients, changed LoRA B weights and saved adapter reload. Separate run discarded before full training.
baseline: Disabled adapter versus saved/reloaded adapted weights, same model revision, test images, prompt, pixel budget, greedy decoding and calculator.
primary: Held-out source A-B endpoint MAE, with unconditional validity/exactness counts, matched-valid errors, base/domain/sharing diagnostics.
exclusions: Previously inspected six underlying fields excluded. All related renders grouped; no fields cross splits.
resource: One A5000, bfloat16, no quantization. Gradient checkpointing and microbatch 1. Full job capped at 90 minutes.
limits: Pilot in one synthetic readable renderer, shared/separate additive offset rules and fixed palette. Not natural visual ambiguity, OOD generalization, novelty or calibrated uncertainty.
